recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-25626. Reconcile later NutritionProduct refinement issues separately only when their own source checks show a remaining current-spec defect.
issue_request: FHIR-25626 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request raised for R5 to create a NutritionProduct resource; the Jira resolution says the change was made in FHIR R5.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-25626 was found. Source history shows b6760dc1c9 added the first NutritionProduct draft files in January 2020 and 9765a2c284 added the active StructureDefinition, examples, terminology/search-parameter files, and fhir.ini registrations in February 2021; the local v5.0.0 tag contains the active resource entry and StructureDefinition.
additional_context: OO Nutrition Confluence minutes from January-May 2020 record work on the NutritionProduct proposal, review of the build resource, and OO approval of NutritionProduct/NutritionIntake proposals pending changes. Current R6 source registers NutritionProduct in fhir.ini and links it from the Nutrition module. Later applied issues such as FHIR-31545 and FHIR-49167 refine boundaries and module-page content but do not reverse the creation decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source already has NutritionProduct in build scope with a StructureDefinition, examples, terminology/search-parameter sources, fhir.ini registrations, and current module-page links.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue clarifying NutritionProduct boundaries with AdministrableProductDefinition; current source includes that boundary text and it does not affect the seed creation decision.
